question: Chart against text: how much the printed disagreements matter

y.label: % of raids that get past the guards

series.label: Chart (27.91): sum at least the defence

finding: Guarded dump raids: the chart's 'at least' lets the raider past the guards up to 16.7 percentage points more often than the text's 'above', at a defence of 7 (58.3 % against 41.7 %); the gap is exactly the chance of rolling the defence. Temporary repair facility: the chart asks 50 fuel and 250 stores in 1 stage, the text (24.82) 150 fuel and 250 stores over 3 stages. Facility rebuild: the chart asks 10 fuel and 50 stores, the text (24.84) 30 fuel and 50 stores.
